newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Eight killed in Sri Lanka army-rebel clashes.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in Sri Lanka army-rebel clashes.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels on Friday ambushed an army patrol in eastern Sri Lanka, killing five soldiers and wounding one, military officials said.

Rebels of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) ambushed the patrol near Seruwila, 240 km (150 miles) from the capital Colombo, as the soldiers returned to barracks in the morning, a military spokesman at the Defence Ministry said.
A Defence Ministry statement said soldiers killed at least three rebels in separate attacks and ambushes on Thursday in the northern and eastern provinces.
Military officials in the east said rebels shot at an air force helicopter and damaged it while it was on a mission to attack rebels in the Welikanda area, 200 km (125 miles) northeast of Colombo.
The LTTE, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in this predominantly Sinhalese Indian Ocean island's north and east, were not immediately available for comment.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is higher.
